name: Snufflenose Owner's Manual
summary: Beside Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet, Snufflenose Owner's Manual shows how to send a trained gopher after Blueleaf Tubers in Razorfen Kraul. Marwig Rustbolt of Snuff Inc. wrote it for that purpose.

sections.title: A Goblin's Operating Guide
sections.body: Marwig Rustbolt of Snuff Inc. wrote the guide for handling the company's trained snufflenose gophers. Their keen noses can find Blueleaf Tubers buried underground from fifty paces away. The manual shows how to release a gopher from a ventilated crate and guide its rooting with a command stick. Prospectors lead it through Razorfen Kraul's thorns and quilboar tunnels in search of tubers.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Snufflenose Owner's Manual?
faq.answer: The manual shows how to release Mebok Mizzyrix's trained snufflenose gopher from its crate and guide it with a command stick. The gopher searches for Blueleaf Tubers in Razorfen Kraul.

faq.q: Where can I find the manual?
faq.answer: You can find the manual in Ratchet beside Mebok Mizzyrix, the crates and the command sticks used to gather tubers.

faq.q: Why are snufflenose gophers needed to find Blueleaf Tubers?
aliases: can i find tubers without gophers
faq.answer: Blueleaf Tubers lie buried deep in Razorfen Kraul, where humanoids can barely spot them. A trained gopher can smell one from fifty paces away.
Marwig Rustbolt, owner of Snuff Inc., signed the manual. He wrote it to teach new owners how to feed, walk and command their gophers with the patented command stick.

angles.text: The manual explains how to retrieve Blueleaf Tubers, an underground root prized as a rare delicacy by gourmands and traders across Azeroth.
